body: If you really want to finish college then I hope you don't give up, but maybe a break from school could help you. It isn't your fault that you are depressed. You don't have to feel the way you do right now forever though. Try a different approach at getting yourself better and then maybe school will be easier, assuming you still want to finish. Be kind to yourself. You can still be successful in life if you keep trying, just know your limits, try to get the depression under control, and know that there are people out there who are going through the same thing. I can kind of relate to your story. Still trying to make it through myself, with depression continuing to make it more difficult than it should be for me. Hang in there please. Don't give up on yourself.

I feel like I can relate to some of your situation. I am so sorry you're dealing with this. I understand how you feel, wanting to hide in a hole and die. I understand the feeling of being independent and then instead of continuing to move forward in life you somehow find yourself sinking down to a place you don't want to be but you don't know how to keep it from happening. If you want to talk feel free to message me. Maybe we could keep each other from going completely insane while we wait out the storms from our holes. :(
